written: 2026-11-11, committed before the camera core's gates G3, G5 to G7, G9 to G12, G15 and the cache, corner and appearance gates ran: the sensor core (mime.sensing), route 1 on spheres, capsules, cylinders and the straight tube
phase: camera lane PR 1, the sensor core (mime.sensing), design rows #358 (1), #359, #360
labels: the builder's predictions, from the design's measured numbers (spike 1's box edge on a 15 px sphere; the fourth review's straight-edge simulation by radius; spike 2's jvp edge) and derivations; guesses say so
seen_before: G1 and G2 were run while the code was written, before this file: G1 passed in both dtypes at 64 ulps of the pixel's scale and its control (k1's sign) failed 28 of the 32 cases (the 4 others undistorted); G2's first draft failed on drawn strong barrels (Newton from the distorted point left the first monotone branch), which the bracketed radial solve replaced. Their numbers here are therefore not predictions.

spike 1 (sphere, 15 px radius, float64, 160x120): the box edge 3.6 to 6.2 % per pixel in its derivative against the exact boundary integral, 0.12 to 0.32 % in silhouette motion, 0.13 % in the image; the 1 px sigmoid 81 % per pixel

the design's fourth review (a straight-edge box filter against an exact circle): derivative error 2.6 % at 15 px, 5.5 % at 6, 8 % at 3, 11 % at 1.5; a 90-degree corner 24 % in coverage with one straight edge
spike 2 (the jvp edge, flat shading, float64): 1.3 % in the silhouette band, 2.8 to 3.9 % per pixel
the frame probe (Actions run 43007629485): every variant finite in both dtypes

operating_point.platform: CPU (CI's lanes; the laptop for development runs only)
operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: 160x120 detectors unless a gate says otherwise; pinhole without distortion where an exact conic is the oracle, Brown-Conrady (k1 -0.05, k2 0.01) elsewhere; a sphere off the optical axis at a projected radius of 15, 6 and 3 px; script A's tube (inner radius 3.175 mm, wall 1.6 mm) seen across from 100 mm
operating_point.seeds_and_draws: Hypothesis draws at physical scales (lens coefficients a calibration gives, poses within the field), never filtered; noise over 400 keys

gate_3_silhouettes.claim: a sphere's covered area and coverage centroid match its analytic conic's area and centroid; a move of a tenth of a pixel moves the coverage centroid by a tenth of a pixel
gate_3_silhouettes.case: tests/sensing/test_silhouettes.py: render of an opaque sphere, 15 px radius, no distortion

prediction.unit: relative area error; centroid within 0.01 px; the sub-pixel move within 2 % of 0.1 px
prediction.why: the box edge is exact where the edge is straight across a pixel; the curvature's error integrates to second order

control.plant: the principal point moved half a pixel (CAMERA_PLANT=principal-half); a hard edge, coverage 1 where the centre's edge function is negative (CAMERA_PLANT=hard-edge)
control.resolution: the centroid oracle's: from discriminating_range.py on the principal point's shift

gate_3_silhouettes.if_wrong: an area error above 0.3 % means the edge's distance or normal is wrong (the jvp line), not its curvature
gate_3_silhouettes.cannot_discriminate_if: the sphere is centred on a pixel's centre and moved along a row (a hard edge's area can then step by symmetry): the gate moves it off a pixel's centre

gate_15_box_edge.claim: the box edge's coverage and its derivative per pixel against the exact pixel areas and the exact boundary integral, by silhouette radius; exact disc coverage exact
gate_15_box_edge.case: tests/sensing/test_box_edge.py: an opaque sphere off-axis at 15, 6 and 3 px radius, pinhole without distortion, derivatives in the centre's x, z, depth and the focal length

prediction.unit: relative L2 over the silhouette's band; motion: the derivative of the equivalent radius and the darkness centroid as one vector's relative error
prediction.why: the straight edge's error is the silhouette's curvature across a pixel, growing as the radius falls; the exact disc is exact up to the oracle's own quadrature

gate_15_box_edge.metric: per-pixel relative L2 of the derivative image in the band; motion of the silhouette

control.plant: the sigmoid at w = 1 px in place of the box edge (CAMERA_PLANT=sigmoid)
control.resolution: the per-pixel line's: from discriminating_range.py on an error planted in the edge's distance

gate_15_box_edge.if_wrong: outside the bands: the jvp line's distance or normal is off; read which parameter
gate_15_box_edge.cannot_discriminate_if: the oracle's own floor (quadrature, the boundary integral's sampling) reaches the line: stated beside each line

gate_5_noise.claim: the frame's counts over noise keys have the expected mean and the variance gain^2 (signal + read^2) + 1/12 (quantisation)
gate_5_noise.case: tests/sensing/test_noise.py: a uniform transmission through Response(full_scale, gain, offset, read_noise), 400 keys

prediction.unit: standard errors of the mean and of the variance
prediction.why: Gaussian shot and read noise, quantisation's uniform rounding

gate_5_noise.metric: z-scores of the mean and the variance

control.resolution: the variance test's: a gain error caught every draw from about 2 % (derived: 400 keys of 256 pixels)

gate_5_noise.if_wrong: the noise's variance or its seeding is wrong
gate_5_noise.cannot_discriminate_if: the signal saturates (the gate's levels stay under full scale)

gate_6_grazing.claim: at a tangent ray and beyond it, every chord, coverage and their derivatives are finite
gate_6_grazing.case: tests/sensing/test_grazing.py: rays built tangent to a sphere, a capsule and a cylinder, and just off them

prediction.why: the grazing root takes a softplus; the edge's distance a floored root

control.plant: the hard clamp sqrt(max(h2, 0)) in place of the softplus (CAMERA_PLANT=hard-clamp)
control.resolution: deterministic: the tangent ray is built exactly

gate_6_grazing.if_wrong: a NaN at grazing in a translucent body's image
gate_6_grazing.cannot_discriminate_if: the built ray is not exactly tangent in the run's dtype (the gate checks its own h2 is zero)

gate_7_media.claim: a translucent sphere in tinted water in a tinted tube wall transmits exp(-mu_w (L_o - L_l) - mu_f (L_l - L_s) - mu_s L_s) at interior pixels; an opaque body is coverage; a robot on the floor within its tolerance raises no flag, one through the wall does

prediction.unit: relative error of the transmission, float64 (float32: 2e-5)
prediction.why: the product form is the displaced-medium rule's exponent exactly while the child lies inside its parent

gate_7_media.metric: relative error at pixels whose centres are 2 px or more inside every silhouette or outside it

control.plant: multiplied transmittances, the child's own attenuation not less its parent's (CAMERA_PLANT=no-displacement); an opaque body as an infinite attenuation (CAMERA_PLANT=infinite)
control.resolution: the transmission line's: from discriminating_range.py on the water's attenuation

gate_7_media.if_wrong: a medium is counted twice or not displaced
gate_7_media.cannot_discriminate_if: the sphere's and the water's attenuations are equal (no displacement shows): they differ by 10x

gate_9_gradients.claim: the darkness centroid's and the covered area's autodiff derivatives in the body's position and in the focal length, principal point and k1 agree with central differences of the same render
gate_9_gradients.case: tests/sensing/test_gradients.py: the sphere in script A's tube, 160x120, Brown-Conrady on, both dtypes

prediction.why: the box edge is C1 in its distance, so aggregates are smooth; central differences at 1e-3 px of motion

gate_9_gradients.metric: relative error of each aggregate's derivative

control.plant: the ray table held (no derivative through the intrinsics: CAMERA_PLANT=held-rays)

gate_9_gradients.if_wrong: a derivative path through the rays or the edge's line is cut
gate_9_gradients.cannot_discriminate_if: a parameter the image does not move (the gate's parameters each move the centroid by a pixel or more per unit step)

gate_10_conventions.claim: the camera prim holds the four conventions as hand numbers give them, and USD's own camera (GfCamera's frustum) projects a point where ours does

prediction.unit: pixels (GfCamera against ours), relative 1e-6 (hand numbers, float32 attributes)
prediction.why: the conversions are exact arithmetic; USD stores apertures as float32

control.plant: +y up taken as +y down (CAMERA_PLANT=y-up); apertures in scene units, not tenths (CAMERA_PLANT=units)

gate_10_conventions.cannot_discriminate_if: a point on the optical axis (the gate projects points off it)

gate_11_refusals.claim: the ellipsoid, the box, the screw and the helix are refused for route 1 with their reasons; route='sampled' is refused; a stale and a traced cache are refused

control.plant: a closed form registered for the screw (CAMERA_PLANT=screw-form)

gate_11_refusals.if_wrong: a kind without a closed form is imaged silently

gate_12_bits.claim: programs without a camera are unchanged
gate_12_bits.cases: script A's arm and the energy ledger's case, float64 and float32, base release/v0.3.0 against this head, one CPU, one BLAS thread (bit_compare.py on a probe)

controls.one_ulp: one parameter one ulp up: differs

gate_12_bits.basis: derived: the PR adds a package and a scene module and changes no node, entry or program

gate_cache.claim: the static cache is refused when any number it was made from changes, and a cached frame equals the uncached one
gate_cache.case: tests/sensing/test_cache.py: Hypothesis draws of one number moved (camera, pose, a static subject's setting, appearance)

prediction.unit: cached against uncached, float64 (float32 1e-6); every moved number refused

control.plant: the key leaves out the principal point (CAMERA_PLANT=key-without-cx)
control.resolution: deterministic per draw; the draws reach cx in every run

gate_cache.if_wrong: a stale structure image would be used silently
gate_cache.cannot_discriminate_if: a draw that moves nothing (the strategy moves by at least a part in a thousand)

gate_corners.claim: a cylinder seen side-on: corner sub-samples bring its corner pixels' coverage within 3 % of the exact rectangle's
gate_corners.case: tests/sensing/test_corners.py: a cylinder across the view, pinhole without distortion, its ends' corners off pixel centres

prediction.unit: absolute coverage error at corner pixels (with 4x4 sub-samples)
prediction.basis: derived: 24 % with one straight edge, sub-pixel corners a sixteenth of the area
prediction.why: a straight edge in each sub-pixel; only the corner's own sub-pixel is wrong

gate_corners.metric: largest absolute coverage error over the corner pixels
gate_corners.if_wrong: the corner test misses a corner pixel
gate_corners.cannot_discriminate_if: a corner on a pixel's centre (the gate places them off)

gate_appearance.claim: a declared appearance wins over the stage's display primvars, which win over the default; the source is reported per subject and the defaulted ones named in the note; display primvars are read with inheritance

control.plant: the stage read before the declaration (CAMERA_PLANT=stage-first)

gate_appearance.if_wrong: an appearance from the wrong source
gate_appearance.cannot_discriminate_if: the declared and the stage's appearance are the same (the gate makes them differ)

outcomes.written: 2026-11-11, after the gates ran (CI on #251 at 8400be3, the evidence probe at 3eaa84f, run 43033788290)
changes_after_seeing_data: G2 (it ran before this file): the first draft's Newton from the distorted point left the first monotone branch on strong barrels; the bracketed radial solve replaced it; the oracle is restricted to the first branch, its tolerance scaled by the inverse's condition, and a flag where the oracle reaches the pixel only at a condition above 4 is allowed (FLAG_CONDITION).

G9 as committed (the whole frame's darkness, the translucent tube's silhouettes in it) failed in both dtypes (float64 2.7e-3 of the derivatives' size against 1e-4; float32 4.6 against 3e-2): central differences of the softplus-smoothed chord at a translucent silhouette need steps under GRAZING R. Re-scoped to the sphere's darkening and an opaque tube; on CI the opaque tube then failed on a centroid whose derivatives all vanish, judged against itself: judged on the aggregate's natural scale.

G15's disc float32 floor (64 ulps) missed: 6e-5 at 15 px, traced to the float32 rounding of the camera's rotation (the image moves about eps x f px); three reformulations of the disc's area left it unchanged to three digits; the floor is 8 eps f px. Float64 holds at the oracle's floor.
G7's float32 line (2e-5) missed on CI (3.9e-5): a chord's rounding times the attenuations; the line is 16 eps (sum of mu) x 0.1 m (4e-4 in float32).

The corner gate's 3 % missed: 13.8 % at the caps' outlines, which this view sees within a pixel of edge-on (their ellipses about half a pixel across); the line is 15 % there with the new thin_cap flag checked; the sides hold 3 %.
Row #361 (after this file): exact disc coverage a sphere's default, always windowed; G9 runs through it in a declared window.
Test files renamed (their basenames are other folders'): test_projection, test_gradients, test_refusals -> test_camera_*; oracles -> camera_oracles.
